_comment: World ruleset for the embodied environment. Pass to game.py via --rules path.json
_comment_safe: All parameters here are safe to change between runs — they do NOT affect observation size.
_comment_unsafe: N_RAYS is NOT in this file. Changing ray count requires rebuilding the brain (different OBS_DIM).
_comment_food_count: Number of food items in the world. More food = easier survival, less pressure to seek.
_comment_danger_count: Number of danger zones. More = stronger avoidance pressure.
_comment_food_respawn_steps: Steps before eaten food reappears (~5s at 60fps). Lower = more food available.
_comment_spawn_near_food: Spawn AI adjacent to a random food item (facing it) so eating reflex gets early signal.
_comment_entity_speed: Pixels per step at full forward input. Higher = faster navigation, harder to stop.
_comment_entity_turn_speed: Radians per step at full turn input (~3.4°). Full 360° turn ≈ 1.7s at 60fps.
_comment_vision_range: Max ray cast distance in pixels. World is 1200×900. Reduce for shorter-range perception.
_comment_satiation_drain_rate: Satiation lost per step. At default, hunger kicks in after ~20000 steps (~5.5min).
_comment_valence_decay_neg: Rate at which negative valence recovers toward 0 per step when not under stress.
_comment_valence_decay_pos: Rate at which positive valence fades toward 0 per step.
_comment_hunger_valence_drain: Valence drain per step when starving (satiation ≤ −1). Net = this − valence_decay_neg.
_comment_danger_life_delay_steps: Steps of continuous danger contact before life starts draining (~3s at 60fps).
_comment_life_drain_rate: Life lost per step once danger drain is active. At default, death takes ~1000 steps.
_comment_food_pleasure: Valence spike on eating food ∈ [0, 1]. This is the primary positive reward signal.
_comment_danger_vision_penalty: Valence penalty per step for danger visible in forward cone (proximity-scaled). Provides approach gradient.
_comment_food_vision_reward: Valence reward per step for food visible in forward cone (proximity-scaled). Kept ≤ danger penalty so avoidance dominates.
_comment_danger_contact_valence_floor: Valence is clamped to this value on direct danger contact (before life drain kicks in). Range [-1, 0]. -0.5 = moderate pain, -1.0 = maximum pain immediately on touch.
